notes.title: 0.18.4 - Early Access Hotfix
notes.notes: [p][b]0.18.4 Early Access Hotfix[/b][/p][list][*][p]\[EXPERIMENTAL] Significantly decreased enemy base health scaling to allow a more casual style of gameplay. This change is aimed at players who do not wish to minmax their builds. The change does not affect the difficulty increase from obelisks. For a casual experience use only a few obelisk shards, for a challenge add as many as you like.[/p][/*][*][p]\[EXPERIMENTAL] Lowered the length of extended rituals to T5. Many players don’t want to risk failing rituals at higher tiers and would rather be able to complete them, even if the rewards don’t differ. For those who prefer longer lasting rituals there are still Shattered Dark Rituals and Endless Mode.[/p][/*][/list][p]Neither of these changes affects the Akka fight, which is meant to remain the ultimate challenge for players.[/p]

notes.title: 0.18.0 - Early Access Update 2
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Awaken, champions![/b][/h3]

It’s been a while since the last patch, but [b]Update 2[/b] is finally here and it's packed with new features and content. This update focuses on reworking and tuning old mechanics, bringing in new ones, a new Shattered Dark ritual, items and abilities to offer a wide range of new build possibilities, and finally some quality of life features requested by the community.

The update took longer than I wanted and going forward during roughly the next month I will be experimenting with more frequent smaller content updates. I’m also still working on the game alone so it is good to set your expectations based on that. I’ve decided to remove Uber Akka from the roadmap for now as the game mode has its issues and is not really the kind of content most players are looking forward to. If I decide to revisit the mode in the future I will implement some more quality of life features to make it more convenient to build up your characters. That said, here’s the updated roadmap:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45331757/720a7cd6b4fb0b1782ab03f13f98175862ce27eb.png"][/img]
As always, let me know your thoughts on the new content either here on the Steam forums or in our [url="https://discord.com/invite/V2YZbE7Wvg"]Discord[/url]. And now let’s move to the actual content of Update 2...

[h3][b]New Shattered Dark Ritual: Tomb of Ulth Vuul[/b][/h3]
Deep within the mountain lies the long-forgotten Tomb of Grand Wizard Ulth Vuul and his servants, once said to have communed with powers beyond the stars. This new Shattered Dark Ritual introduces the second large map into Conquest Dark, along with new items and abilities to acquire, and a new enemy type.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45331757/d92cded7d03707584da8c219153fecec009c8fe8.png"][/img]

[h3][b]New Events: Forsworn Champions and Aura’s Gift[/b][/h3]
In the Forsworn Champions Event another Fated One that has abandoned their cause now appears and tries to interrupt the player’s ritual. These champions are minibosses with random looks, armor, weapons, and abilities. They also bleed just like the player character.

With the Aura’s Gift Event, Aura, the Goddess of the Sun, spawns a prism at a random location on the map where the player must defeat a number of enemies to claim the offering inside before it disappears.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45331757/f55fb7d50cfc9daa86ef6cf0e4143297a606270d.png"][/img]

[h3][b]New Item Type: Unique Items[/b][/h3]
Unique Items are a new item type that can appear as a special roll on any rarity (Common, Exceptional, and Ancient) and are hidden unlocks gained by progressing through the game. Each rarity and item slot type has its own unique items. Unique Items do not have any proficiency requirements so all classes can obtain them. The update adds 16 Unique Armor Items to the game with more planned for future updates.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45331757/21a1fa3883e3a98572e11e6b95558de98c4d2417.png"][/img]

[b]Note:[/b] In the previous roadmap Unique Weapons and Armor were mentioned as coming in Update 3. The system described there is not the same as the one implemented in this update and has now been renamed to [b]Eldritch Weapons and Armor[/b] instead.

[h3][b]Reworked Altars[/b][/h3]
The goal for Altars has always been a system where you can infinitely dump resources to gain small permanent upgrades. With the previous design the altars quickly softcapped and players could not interact with the system without an excessive amount of grinding.

Reworked Altars now consist of multiple predetermined stats, and the stat and its amount are randomly chosen each time a player offers Corrupted Soul Fragments on the altar, working more as a ‘gambling’ system. When you get a set of stats you like you can bind them to keep them and safely make new offerings without losing the good binded roll.

An altar also has a Tier that increases each time a player discovers the same Altar in multiple world map locations. Altar Tier increases the total amount of stats affected by offerings and the maximum range that stats can roll in.

The number of altars has also been reduced and all Corrupted Soul Fragments used to upgrade the previous version of altars have been refunded.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45331757/9308ad4608605c8b5b7561ffdf84848ca4045328.png"][/img]

[h3][b]New Weapon Sets, Abilities, Artifacts and More[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New Weapon Set: Brutal Flail & Battlefield Shield[/p][/*][*][p]New Weapon Set: Lesser Arcane Missiles[/p][/*][*][p]New Power Ability: Greater Arcane Missiles[/p][/*][*][p]New Power Ability: Snake Shot[/p][/*][*][p]New Passive Ability: Sunfire Beams[/p][/*][*][p]New Movement Ability: Savage Kick[/p][/*][*][p]New Artifact: Thrumming Femur[/p][/*][*][p]New Artifact: Blood of Ulth Vuul[/p][/*][*][p]New Runes: Gul (Rerolls, Infinite); Anh (Damage To Injured), Unh (Damage to Elites) and Onh (Damage to Healthy), Yiln (Additional Rune Slots, Reworked)[/p][/*][*][p]New Origin: Aura’s Chosen[/p][/*][/list]
[h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Abilities are now acquired one character level earlier.[/p][/*][*][p]Extended Normal Rituals now last until Tier 10 (up from Tier 5), allowing players to more efficiently farm resources and scrolls from these locations especially when combined with beneficial Ritual Modifiers.[/p][/*][*][p]Extended Dark Rituals now have one additional boss in their spawning pool.[/p][/*][*][p]Skipping Exceptional items now grants 2 reroll tokens and skipping Ancient items grants 3.[/p][/*][*][p]Runes will now drop even if the player has filled all available Rune Slots. Picking up a Rune this way will automatically grant one Reroll Token. No need to save that last Rune Slot for rerolls anymore.[/p][/*][*][p]Runes that change Ability Damage Type can now be used multiple times.[/p][/*][*][p]Staggered Damage from a single source can no longer exceed a character’s maximum health. This does not affect the total amount of Staggered Damage that a character can accumulate.[/p][/*][*][p]Losing a life or leveling up now removes all accumulated Staggered Damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[EXPERIMENTAL][/b] Added an option to change game speed to 1x, 1.5x, or 2x. Separate keybinds can be used during gameplay to change the speed without having to enter the menu. On lower end machines increased game speed might cause performance issues and physics bugs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[EXPERIMENTAL][/b] Added an 'Enrage Timer' to boss fights activating after a certain amount of time has passed. Once active the player begins to slowly lose health with the rate increasing over time. The timer is set to 3 minutes for most bosses, 5 minutes for some end bosses and each phase of the Akka fight, and 8 minutes for Azgoroth the Doombringer.
[quote][i][b]Developer Comment:[/b] Conquest Dark gives players a lot of freedom in how to build their characters, but this also leads to the possibility of building characters in a not very optimal way. One common complaint from players is that bosses have too much health, feel like sponges and the fights drag on for too long. Boss/enemy durability is always relative to how much damage your character does and in most cases the fights dragging on is a direct result of unoptimal builds or the character’s abilities/runes not being upgraded enough. This change now provides a resolution to these situations that ends the fight instead of allowing it to go on forever.

It also fixes some corner cases where players delay killing bosses to collect excessive amounts of power. While this is not the intended way to play the game I understand it is something some players enjoy and that is why the enrage timer is disabled in Arena of Ikar to allow those days-long infinite runs.

The change will also negatively affect some heavy defensive builds like damage reflection Oathkeeper. These kinds of builds will get new items and mechanics in the future updates to allow them to do proper damage to bosses.[/i][/quote][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Visuals[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Updated visuals for some enemy projectiles and AOE effects to make them easier to see. [/p][/*][*][p]Corrected lighting issues in some shaders.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted lighting and visuals on The Pale Desolation map.[/p][/*][*][p]Zarakesh Set has a new headpiece visual.[/p][/*][/list]
[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Players can now move back from the Rune Category Selection to choose another Ability to imbue the rune into.[/p][/*][*][p]Rearranged unlock categories in The Stygian Archive so that items which can be upgraded are more easily accessible. Added an Upgradeable tag to all categories that can be upgraded.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new icon to Deadly Strikes mastery.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the look of multiple other icons.[/p][/*][*][p]Staggered Damage is now displayed as a jagged edge on the player's health bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Damage Meters now measure the actual damage done to a target’s health and barriers instead of the raw damage dealt by abilities. This gives a more realistic picture of how abilities contribute to killing enemies as overflowing damage is not counted.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to make Zordolf Mode instant, skipping the selection screen animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a hotkey and UI icon for Zordolf Mode. This can be toggled on and off with the default Z key. The Damage Meter default key is now X (previously Z).[/p][/*][*][p]Zordolf can now browse and select runes beyond the first page when Zordolf Mode is active.[/p][/*][/list]
[h3][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h3][b]General[/b][list][*][p]Increased the available time in Shattered Dark Ritual for each wave.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Shattered Dark Ritual experience requirements (Previous values were incorrectly left at those used for testing):[/p][list][*][p]Levels 11–20 require 50% more.[/p][/*][*][p]Levels 21–25 require 100% more.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Damage done increase and damage taken increase from holding Dark Soul Fragments reduced from 1% to 0.25% per fragment.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the placement and quantity of some rewards on World Map locations.[/p][/*][*][p]Arena of Ikar resource and scroll drops further reduced from 50% to 25% of normal.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the base drop chance of Corrupted Soul Fragments from multiple sources by roughly 50%. Reduced the obelisk soul fragment bonus by 50%.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the Common Soul Coin cost of upgrading Weapon Sets and Abilities by roughly 30%. Reduced the obelisk common soul coin drop chance bonus by roughly the same amount.
[i][quote][b]Developer Comment:[/b] The intention of these changes is to increase the base rate at which players upgrade altars and abilities without using obelisk bonuses. Using obelisks is still the most efficient way to grind resources for upgrades.[/quote][/i][/p][/*][/list][b]Stats[/b][list][*][p]Damage to Elites base value increased from 15% to 25%.[/p][/*][*][p]Passive Ability Damage base value increased from 15% to 25%.[/p][/*][*][p]Movement Ability Damage base value increased from 25% to 100%.[/p][/*][/list]
[p][b]Races[/b][/p][list][*][p]Human racial bonus stat Chance to Spawn a Healing Soul lowered from 5% to 2.5%.[/p][/*][/list]
[p][b]Enemies[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced the cast speed of elite mages by 50%. Bosses and normal enemies are unaffected.[/p][/*][*][p]Witch Smeller Mzawi now has a new ability effect for Twirling Skulls.[/p][/*][*][p]Witch Smeller Mzawi Twirling Skulls damage increased from 50% to 100%.[/p][/*][*][p]Giant type enemies Base Health reduced from 250% to 175%.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased enemy teleport cooldown from 8 to 10 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Herald of Kuu barrier recharge rate reduced by 50%.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy mass no longer increases per tier, making enemies easier to push back on higher tiers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[EXPERIMENTAL] [/b]Enemy movement speed now scales less between tiers T1 and T5, and the maximum movement speed on higher tiers is lower.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[EXPERIMENTAL] [/b]Lowered maximum enemy Crowd Control Resistance from 95% to 75% (at Tier 10). This does not apply to special bosses such as Akka, which still has 90%.[/p][/*][/list]
[p][b]Set Bonuses[/b][/p][list][*][p]Cultist Set 3-set bonus Critical Strike Damage increased from 50% to 100%.[/p][/*][*][p]Stalker Set 3-set bonus Attack Speed increased from 7.5% to 30%.[/p][/*][*][p]Kharathia Set 3-set bonus Critical Strike Damage increased from 50% to 100%.[/p][/*][*][p]Savage Set 2-set bonus changed to 50% Bonus Health.[/p][/*][*][p]Savage Set 3-set bonus changed to 5% Damage Increased per Life Lost.[/p][/*][*][p]Zarakesh Set 3-set bonus Increased Proc Chance increased from 20% to 30%.[/p][/*][/list]
[p][b]Weapon Sets, Abilities and Artifacts[/b][/p][list][*][p]Most Weapon Sets have had their stat bonuses adjusted or reworked. In general weapons are now more powerful than before.[/p][/*][*][p]Oathbringer damage type changed from Primal to Solar.[/p][/*][*][p]Oathbringer stat bonus changed from Chance to Stun with Primal Damage to Damage to Elites.[/p][/*][*][p]Oathbringer damage increased from 80% to 150%.[/p][/*][*][p]Oathbringer energy generated per hit increased from 12 to 15.[/p][/*][*][p]Blade of Akka damage increased from 150% to 200%.[/p][/*][*][p]Ricochet Shot damage increased from 250% to 300%.[/p][/*][*][p]Holy Bolts damage increased from 125% to 150%.[/p][/*][*][p]Execute damage increased from 250% to 500%.[/p][/*][*][p]Arcane Orbs damage variance reduced from 50% to 25%.[/p][/*][*][p]Leap impact area reach increased from 1.5 to 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Shard of a Dying Star damage reduced from 5% to 3%.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Frost Arrow Barrage ability from the game. This ability was added before it was possible to swap the damage type of an ability with runes and is a now just a worse version of Fire Arrow Barrage. One of the duplicate trap abilities will be removed from the game later.[/p][/*][/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where lootable items could sometimes get stuck inside the Arena of Ikar walls.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an audio bug that could trigger an error message.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where enemies would sometimes gain movement charge immediately after spawning. This was most noticeable with teleporting enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a texture bug on the enemy Savage Set.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused Band of Primal Power to use its previous proc chance of 15% instead of the displayed 10%. It now uses the correct value of 10%.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that sometimes caused gamepads to have twitchy menu movement.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a major bug where the barrier recharge cooldown wouldn’t trigger when hit would bring barrier to 0.
[i][quote][b]Developer Comment:[/b] This made Herald of Kuu especially hard to kill.[/quote][/i][/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p]

notes.title: 0.17.0 - Early Access Update 1
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,

It's time for the first content update to Conquest Dark since the Early Access release. This update focuses on the most requested features by the community, along with quality of life improvements, bug fixes, optimizations and balance changes. Not all community requests made it into this update, and some didn’t work out as well as expected and were dropped (the hardcore mode toggle, for example). 

This update also changes some of the underlying mechanics of the game and may result in a different gameplay feel than what you're used to. The same builds might not be as effective and character power in some parts may not be comparable to what the previous version of the game had. Some things might be more off balance than they were previously and will require additional balance patches. Before judging the new changes too quickly give them some time and then provide feedback through Steam or our [url="https://discord.com/invite/V2YZbE7Wvg"]Discord channel[/url].

[u][b]Major Features:[/b][/u]

[b]Improved Character Creation[/b][/p][list][*][p]Character Race, Class and Origin can now be picked separately. Character visuals and traits are still under reroll, as I wanted to leave a bit of that randomized roguelite feeling to it. It's worth noting that the character traits are there just for flavor and are so minuscule that they don't really matter. Don't worry about rolling perfect ones.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Damage Meters[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added damage meters that record and display the total damage done by abilities and some other damage sources. You can turn this feature on from the options and also bind a hotkey to toggle it during gameplay. Holding down the activation key while the damage meters are active will reset them. This feature will be further enhanced based on player feedback and needs.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Gameplay:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Soul Coins, Corrupted and Dark Soul Fragments are now affected by soul attract range and are pulled toward the player when nearby.[/p][/*][*][p]Bleeding can now once again cause the player to lose lives, but it cannot deal the final fatal damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Characters can no longer lose multiple lives from a single source of damage. This applies to both the player and enemies.[/p][/*][/list][quote][p][i]Developer Notes:[/i]
The bleeding system has been controversial from the beginning and one of the earlier hotfixes tried to fix it but unfortunately introduced other problems and imbalance in the game. The above changes aim to bring back the original bleed without making it too punishing, especially with the changes to how the player can lose lives.[/p][/quote][p]
[b]User Interface:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added alternative keybindings for movement and menu navigation. By default, these are bound to the arrow keys.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to lock the mouse cursor to the window.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved existing Game Guide entries and added new ones.[/p][/*][*][p]Reroll Tokens are now displayed alongside other resources.[/p][/*][*][p]Added kill counter back to the game. This is now tied to Damage Meters UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Zordolf twitter/X button.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Visuals:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Mirage type enemies now have more noticeable visual effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the size of Souls and made them stand out more.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabling visual damage on player characters now also affects Death Touched characters during character creation.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Misc:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated Unity Engine to 6.1 version.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to reset all progression.[/p][/*][*][p]Rewrote the save system from scratch, which should now result in fewer issues with some corner cases that led to loss of progression. [i]Note:[/i] you should avoid quitting the game or Steam using Alt + F4 as this can still lead to corrupted save files. Additionally this does not affect how Steam Auto-Cloud Sync works and it might cause separate issues. In some cases you might want to turn this feature off in Steam for Conquest Dark.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug with Projectile Duration stat that prevented it from working correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that sometimes displayed an incorrect amount of Dodge and Movement Charges on gear.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Thief's Daggers were showing an incorrect number of runes in the rune category selection.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Eye of the Berserker was not applied to the first projectile attack performed while it was active.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[u][b]Balance:[/b][/u]

[b]Energy Generation[/b][/p][list][*][p]All Primary Attack Abilities (Weapon Sets) that can hit multiple targets now have diminishing returns on energy generation to even out the differences between them. Single target abilities always start very strong and multi target abilities catch up on later once they start hitting between 5 to 10 targets. Energy generation beyond 10 targets is now 0 in most cases. This will lead into a noticeable power drop especially on very late game arena builds. Energy generation on all energy generating abilities has been adjusted.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Hammer of Sol[/b][/p][list][*][p]No longer generates energy from the AoE portion of the attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Damage increased from 50% to 60%.[/p][/*][*][p]Can now be imbued with Djur Rune (Projectile Split Chance).[/p][/*][/list][p]

notes.title: Conquest Dark Early Access Roadmap
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Hail, Fated Ones![/b][/h3]

It’s been a super exciting launch week for [i]Conquest Dark[/i], and we’ve been closely watching all your feedback. Some of it has already been addressed with hotfixes, while other larger changes will take a bit more time to do properly. A few of the most requested changes will be included in the next bigger update.

We’ve also prepared a roadmap to give you a glimpse of what’s coming in future updates including some of the bigger features looming on the horizon, like a new class and translations. Between each major update, there will also be ongoing balance changes, bug fixes, and maybe even a few surprises. The roadmap is subject to change, and your feedback plays a huge role in shaping it! Be sure to [url=http://discord.gg/V2YZbE7Wvg]join our Discord [/url]channel and share your thoughts there.

As a final reminder, the game is still being solo-developed, so things will take the time they need. It’s totally fine to take breaks, spend time with your favorite ARPGs and survivor-likes, and return when new updates drop!

notes.title: Conquest Dark is Now Live!
notes.notes:
[h1]Step forth, Fated Ones![/h1]
What a journey it has been... Conquest Dark has been in development for almost three years and I am beyond excited to finally share it with you. What started as a simple hobby project to create something cool over a weekend has grown into a proper sword & sorcery epic. Now, it is ready to take its first steps into the world through Steam Early Access.

[previewyoutube=Uq7-6ZAYU6E;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]What to Expect from Early Access[/h3]
Early Access will be an adventure of its own. Expect the usual: bugs, balance issues and the occasional performance spikes. While a roadmap is in place, it is not set in stone. Player feedback will play a significant role in shaping the future of the game, so please keep sharing your thoughts!

As a final note, Conquest Dark is still a solo-developed project. Updates will come, but they will take the time they need. Quality over haste will be the guiding principle. The detailed roadmap will be shared in a separate blog post shortly after launch.

[h3]Final Thanks and Launch Bundles[/h3]
Once again, a big thank you to everyone who has supported the game so far. I hope you enjoy the journey ahead.

notes.title: Updated Demo and Early Access Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Harken, friends![/b][/h1]

Over the past few months, Conquest Dark has undergone significant iteration and expansion based on community feedback. Among these changes are the addition of collectible, upgradeable runes that can be imbued into abilities, further enhancing customization and greatly increasing build diversity. I've also completed a full balance pass on gear and abilities, including complete reworks of some and refined in-game mechanics—such as ensuring minor enemies can no longer interrupt player attacks. Additionally, numerous quality-of-life improvements have been made, particularly to the UI, and key mechanics are now better explained to reduce confusion.

All of this is now available in an updated demo, playable right now, as part of Steam Next Fest! On top of these enhancements, I've also introduced a brand-new Thief class and added a new playable mode / level, The Pale Desolation, allowing players to explore beyond the boundaries of the Ritual Circle.

There’s still work to be done before the game is ready for Steam Early Access, but we are now confident enough to announce that [b]the Early Access release date is April 30th![/b] Check out the new trailer below, and remember to Wishlist the game and leave a demo review if you haven't already!
